book.name: 2 KORINTI
book.title: KORINTI KINA'MI NKISA PORO KAENTIYE (TARA YAGANE)

content: Naeba Porona, Karaisiti Isu nkaposoro Koti nkabemika unatantiye. Piya, naebe tao'yagara Timotibe, tasigeba Korinti kumata Koti mponota ai'aru pe kina'mititibe, Akaiya mari Kotiti atokaeya kina'mititibe, tigeti ma nkisapa kaeyuse.
Pigoya, tabarempa Koti, Wa'ega Isu Karaisiti, isigetisa awagaenabe paruyenabe tigeti waiyeno.
Koti Poro ao'maeyomeka a'mu potantiye
Pigoya, taeba Wa'egare Isu Karaisiti nkaba Koti ta'mu potama agiseno. Piya, tabarempa aeba antara'enama nkagowe. Pi Kotirempa aeba agoya puratakenama nkagowe.
Piya, taeba a'ya'ma tauki nakiyenabi mpiyompeka agoya purataye. Eya, Koti agoya puratamisa puma taeba pabiyama iki nakiyenabi mpiye'nagipa kanara agoya puwaitaiyoma tao'maeye.
Piya, Karaisiti ae kuntuyenama nkatunkapa tabera taeti aboraisa pumagina, pabiyama Karaisitibisa agoyaenawapa taeti tabera aboraramiwaye.

Piya, taeti tauki nakiyenaba aboraramemipa, pipa tigeka agoya puritama ti'ikenaga aboraramiye. Kotiba agoya puratamipa, pipa tigeka agoya puritakenaga aboraramiye. Piya, tae puratamisa puma aborariminti kuntaenaba kaga aesaga'ma paebuma miyigina Koti pi nkagoyaenawapa puritakiri miyiyo.
We taeba tigeka tara tara tagiba kampa napinta, mayama napima esegi pune: Tigeba kuntaenarepa asima kubo pukibepa, taegeba kaga agoyaenarapa asima kabo pukibewema, abuntune.

We nao'mitaba, taeba Esiya mari miyuwakini tauki nakiyenaba tabera aboraraminti, pika aibo pusanaga kamana urimekiri abiyo: Pita'iba kuntaenama agasiya puratama esegiyenarepa asuragasima taerari kaeyoga: Mikenaenarepa nagariwakiyema, napintune.

Piya, taeka: Iyeguyigini puriyoma, utaratantisa puma aboraramintiye. Pipa uwaba kampaye. Taeba taete nkesegiyenarekaba kampa napinta Kotiti atokaekenaga aboraramintiye. Eya, Koti aeba purintapisa asiwaitakena esegiyenawa nkwainta yagaramati esegima tamatiti potakenaga aboraramintiye.
Piya, taeguyigi purikenaena pi ataenabisa Kotiba taba puratantiye. Piya, aintiba to kakema taba pukiye. Eya, esegima aeti tamatiti pekana to kakema taba pikiye.
We, tigegeba nunamubisa tao'maeyiyo. Piya pigina Kotiba uwaena kina'mi ntunamu abintana agoya puratakiye. Agoya puratagiri uwaena kina'mitaba tigeba pika ti'mu potaigina kanarasano.
Poro aeba Korinti kinapa ata kamana kampa uwaimintiye

Piya, taeba mantanaga ta'mupa pune: Taeba mampara a'ya'ma kina'mi nkikapipa aogima ntasimagi, pabiyama tige tikapi asugasima aogima ntasintompene. Piya, taeba aota puma Koti pisa puma tagantana puntune. Mabisa kina'mi ntapiyenamaba kampa aboramagi, taeba Koti nkawagaenabisa kamanatepa aborantune. Eya, tagu taumarempaba: Pipa tagantanawe, iye.
Ma kamanapa tigetiba kaeyompepa, agowapa pipa kampa kakantiye. Kampaye. Kaema timopa aisuma abiyo. Piya, nae nabemika tigeba agowapa abiwaekibewe.
Eya, paipa tigeba ka'isa abintakina nae nabemika abiwaeyiyo. Piya pikibepa, Wa'ega Isu kanabipa taeba tigeka ta'mu pukubompesa puma tigeba taeka ti'mu pukenaga napiyiyo.
Piya, tigeba pikaba kanara napikibewema abibebe punta, paitama tigeti wakuwe, untone. Pipa kayone puritakenaga tara yaga tigeti aborakuwema napintone.

Eya, naeba pabiyama napimagi paitama tigeti wama urigaitegi Masetoniya mari wakuwema napintone. Piti umigategi to kakema a'wae puma Masetoniya maba agaite to tigeti kanakiripa, Yutiya mari wakenaga nao'maeyiyoma napintone.

We, naekaba nanawe yewe. Pi kamana'nepa naeba tara nagi napinta a'yugu kamana untona, a. We, naeba ka'ena pikena pontanaba, pipa mampabisa kina'mi yesa suwa: Owe, owe, kampaye, kampaye, kaga yesa suma yuwa, a. We, pipa kampaye.
Kotiba tagantana puma tao'maeyoga taeba urimintompe kamanatepa owebe kampayebe kaga kampa untune.

Piya, naebe Sairasibe Timotibe taeba Koti Ntagara Isu Karaisitika kamana urimintune. Piya, Karaisiti aeba tara agi kampa napinta, owe a'a-o kaga kampa untiye. Kampaye. Aewapa owe uma asi nasiba tagantana piye.
Eya, a'ya'ma Koti utaratanti kamanaka Karaisiti owe uma au'wapa aborawaeye. Pika taeba Koti kamanapa abimagi, Karaisiti nkagerapa taeba tagane uma Koti nkageba asagayuyune.
Piya, Kotiba tigepe taepe Karaisititi kaga atokaeratamagina esegima asiratama yogaretapa utarataye.
Piya, ae'wa nkara'ena puratama Awamusa'wapa tagupipa ataogana tumintiye. Piya, aintiba a'ya'waemaena aboraramikenaga awame'ena taminti, pipa Awamusane.
Poroba kampa agaropa igetiba wantiye
Pigoya, naeba Korinti kumatiba wama namo'ena puritasanaga kampa wantone. Piya, kamana'nepa Koti pipa abintegi taga taga yuwe.
We, taeba timatiti'enaritapa tabe kina kanta puritakenagaba kampa yune. Kampaye. Taeba tiyo'maeyakiri ti'muntanabi miyiyoma, yune. Piya, tigeba timatiti'enayaga esegima asima mintapa, pipa abuntune.
